findings.title: Passing immediateDelete=true on reschedule bypasses the deferred SendGrid cancellation fix
findings.body: In `handleNewBooking.ts` (when rescheduling a booking) and in `workflows.tsx` (lines 214 and 521, when deleting a workflow or a workflow step), `deleteScheduledEmailReminder` is called with `immediateDelete = true`. In `emailReminderManager.ts` (lines 213-223), when `immediateDelete` is true, the function immediately calls `POST /v3/user/scheduled_sends` on SendGrid instead of marking `cancelled: true` for the cron job to cancel within the 1-hour window, and it also returns early without deleting or updating the `workflowReminder` row in the database. Because workflow steps and workflow reminders are not deleted when a booking is rescheduled (and `immediateDelete` skips the DB update/delete), this both leaves stale `workflowReminder` records in the database and reintroduces the exact SendGrid 100-pending-cancellations limit problem described in the PR for rescheduled bookings and deleted workflows/steps.

findings.title: @sendgrid/client API key is never set in scheduleEmailReminders cron handler
findings.body: `scheduleEmailReminders.ts` imports `client` from `@sendgrid/client` and uses `client.request(...)` at lines 57 and 188, but only calls `sgMail.setApiKey(sendgridAPIKey)` at line 19 and never calls `client.setApiKey(sendgridAPIKey)`. Unless `emailReminderManager.ts` happens to have been imported in the same serverless instance before this API route runs, `@sendgrid/client` has no API key configured and all requests to `/v3/user/scheduled_sends` (to cancel emails) and `/v3/mail/batch` will fail with 401 Unauthorized.

findings.title: Unawaited async reminder cancellation calls in forEach loops
findings.body: In `handleCancelBooking.ts` (lines 485-493), `handleNewBooking.ts` (lines 966-972), `bookings.tsx` (lines 488-494), and `workflows.tsx` (lines 212-218, 376-382, 519-525, 574-580), `deleteScheduledEmailReminder` and `deleteScheduledSMSReminder` are async functions invoked inside `.forEach(...)` without `await` or `Promise.all`. In serverless/API route environments, the handler can finish and return the response (or proceed to subsequent DB operations like `workflow.deleteMany` / `workflowStep.delete` in `workflows.tsx`, which cascade-delete the `WorkflowReminder` rows) before the Prisma updates/deletes or Twilio/SendGrid API calls inside those functions complete, causing race conditions, P2025 record-not-found errors, or dropped cancellations.
